title: Cross-region Cutover Commander and Ops Handbook for coordinated runtime/console/api releases
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a single pragmatic handbook and lightweight orchestration pattern for cross-region coordinated cutovers that involve the runtime, console, and API surfaces. This ticket covers: 1) defining the Cutover Commander role and deputies, 2) a phased preflight checklist (capacity, canary shadow, observability smoke tests), 3) sequential cutover lanes per region with explicit time-boxed gating criteria, 4) automated gating instrumentation (dashboards and burn signals), 5) communications templates and escalation matrix, and 6) a minimal set of scripts/automation to execute the coordinated switch and fast rollback. The handbook must balance operational safety with velocity so mid-market customers can adopt the same patterns as enterprise launches. Deliverables: Confluence handbook, ops runbook (Markdown), a GitHub repo with helper scripts, dashboard templates for Console, and a post-mortem template. Success measures: reproducible cutover (run in staging across 3 regions), <5% error delta during canary window, rollback within agreed RTO under 15 minutes, and cross-team sign-off from Eng/Infra/Security/Support.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence handbook published and linked in runbook
Checklist automated where possible (capacity reservation, smoke tests, KV cache priming)
Cutover Commander role defined with contact roster and on-call rotation
Observable gating dashboards implemented (latency, error rates, token burn) and tested in staging
Two rehearsal runs completed (one daytime, one night) with incident timelines captured
Rollback procedure rehearsed and demonstrated to meet RTO < 15 minutes
Cross-team sign-off recorded (ENG, Infra, Product, Support, Security)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Regional capacity depletion during canary — Mitigation: pre-reserve burst lanes and fallback to lower-cost model variant
Risk: Automation script with elevated permissions — Mitigation: require short-lived tokens via KMS and RBAC approval workflow
Risk: Telemetry gaps across regions — Mitigation: synthetic traffic probe and heartbeat monitors before cutover
tradeoffs: Tradeoff: Strict time-boxed cutover reduces blast radius but increases rehearsal overhead
Tradeoff: More automation reduces human error but requires higher security gating and audits
